title: The Data-Centre Energy-Control Claim Qualification Benchmark
description: Publication package containing the October 2026 preprint by Babasola Adeboye Osibo, MBL, MS, Pentrest Global (b.osibo@pentrestglobal.com), together with the benchmark’s existing software, figures and compact results. The manuscript reports benchmark version 0.2.1. This packaging release adds the approved PDF manuscript; it does not introduce new experiments or results.
